verdict.rationale: Gladia's docs point users to official integration partners Zapier, Make and n8n for no-code and workflow automation. That gives a vendor-documented route to event-triggered actions, but the rules would be defined in those third-party tools rather than in Gladia itself, and the evidence describes no native rule engine, triggers or webhooks. missing for 10: a native rules/trigger engine in Gladia, documented webhooks or event callbacks, details on which Gladia events the Zapier/Make/n8n connectors expose, hands-on or independent corroboration
